run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded run - outbound HTTPS (WebFetch) was entirely blocked by the environment network egress policy (blanket block confirmed: even example.com and www.tenders.gov.au returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, and the agent proxy status reported no relay failures - this is an organization-level egress restriction, not a per-site fault, and per /root/.ccr/README.md such policy denials must be reported, not routed around). Only the WebSearch tool was functional. WebSearch DID surface genuine, currently-relevant opportunities across Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW eTendering, Tenders ACT, NT/TAS/SA/WA/VIC portals) and Tier 2 (Greater Western Water GBE, CSIRO, TAFE SA, councils), captured here at HEADLINE level only from result snippets. Because no tender detail page could be opened, tender IDs, exact closing times, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, values and contacts are UNVERIFIED and left null - every tender entry is flagged in its notes and counted in entries_pending_detail. Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woodside, EstimateOne) was checked and is entirely login/registration-gated: no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found, so no corporate tenders were invented; the portals are recorded in discovered_sources with access_method=portal-registration. Source discovery still ran and found new buyer-originated sources.
gaps: WebFetch/outbound-HTTPS entirely egress-blocked this run (EGRESS_BLOCKED on every domain tested, incl. www.tenders.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, example.com). No tender detail page, RSS/Atom feed, JSON/REST API, or specification document could be opened or paginated.

All 10 captured tenders are headline-only from WebSearch snippets; tender_id, closing_time, deliverables, requirements, evaluation_criteria, value and contacts are unverified against the source notice (pending a future authenticated/unblocked detail pass).

Tier 1 portals (AusTender, buy.nsw/NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders TAS, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) could not be queried live or swept exhaustively - only snippet-level results were available.

Tier 3 corporate opportunities are registration- or invitation-gated (SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP SmartProcure, Rio Tinto Ariba/Local Buying, Fortescue, Woodside, EstimateOne). No authenticated session available, so individual corporate RFx could not be read; invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.

NT 'Nolans Project' packages (e.g. PM044 Product Bagging) surfaced in snippets but with inconsistent/future publish dates and unclear buyer-originated provenance, so they were deliberately NOT captured as tenders to avoid fabrication.
SA Tenders and Contracts noted scheduled maintenance ~20 Aug 2026 in a snippet (informational).
recommended_seed_additions: https://www.buyingfor.vic.gov.au/find-opportunities (Buying for Victoria companion/rebrand front-end - possible Tier 1 VIC change to track)
